# Appendix 4 {#sec-appendix-4}

```{r echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
#| label: tbl-ttable
#| tbl-cap: "t Table: critical values of the t distribution for a given degrees of freedom (df) and cumulative probability."

library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

dt <- read.csv(
  "csv/ttable.csv",
  check.names = FALSE,
  colClasses = "character"
)

dt <- rbind(dt,
            c("Confidence Level", "0%", "50%", "60%", "70%", "80%",
              "90%", "95%", "98%", "99%"))

colnames(dt) <- c("two-tails", "1.00", "0.50", "0.40", "0.30", "0.20",
                   "0.10", "0.05", "0.02", "0.01")

dt <- rbind(c("df", "", "", "", "", "", "", "", "", ""), dt)

n <- nrow(dt)

# Wrap header labels in an 8px span so the stacked header rows
# added via add_header_above() match the body font size.
span8 <- function(x) {
  paste0('<span style="font-size: 8px;">', x, '</span>')
}

cum_prob_labels <- c("cum. prob.", "0.50", "0.75", "0.80", "0.85",
                      "0.90", "0.95", "0.975", "0.99", "0.995")
one_tail_labels <- c("one-tail", "0.50", "0.25", "0.20", "0.15",
                      "0.10", "0.05", "0.025", "0.01", "0.005")

cum_prob <- setNames(rep(1, length(cum_prob_labels)), span8(cum_prob_labels))
one_tail <- setNames(rep(1, length(one_tail_labels)), span8(one_tail_labels))

out <- kbl(
  dt,
  escape = FALSE,
  booktabs = FALSE,
  align = "c"
) %>%
  kable_classic(
    full_width = FALSE,
    html_font = "Arial"
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = c(
      "HOLD_position",
      "repeat_header",
      "scale_down"
    ),
    bootstrap_options = c(
      "bordered",
      "striped",
      "condensed"
    )
  ) %>%
  add_header_above(one_tail, bold = TRUE, escape = FALSE) %>%
  add_header_above(cum_prob, bold = TRUE, escape = FALSE) %>%
  row_spec(
    0,
    bold = TRUE,
    extra_css = paste(
      "font-family: Arial, sans-serif;",
      "font-size: 8px !important;"
    )
  ) %>%
  row_spec(
    n - 1,
    bold = TRUE,
    background = "#DCE6F1"
  ) %>%
  row_spec(
    n,
    bold = TRUE
  ) %>%
  column_spec(
    1:ncol(dt),
    extra_css = paste(
      "font-family: Arial, sans-serif;",
      "font-size: 8px !important;"
    )
  ) %>%
  column_spec(
    1,
    bold = TRUE
  )

# PDF / LaTeX
if (knitr::is_latex_output()) {
  out <- out %>%
    kable_styling(font_size = 6) %>%
    landscape()
}

# HTML
if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
  out <- out %>%
    scroll_box(width = "100%")
}

out
```

::: {.callout-important}
## Note
Row **z** in @tbl-ttable gives the critical values of the standard normal distribution, which the t distribution approaches as degrees of freedom (df) increase. For df > 1000, the t distribution is practically indistinguishable from the standard normal.
:::
